title: Settings
description: Manage your account settings and set e-mail preferences.
accountDescription: Manage your preferred time zone and regional formatting.
appearanceDescription: Customize the appearance of the app. Automatically switch between day and night themes.
notificationDescription: Manage optional meeting and action item email communications.
profileDescription: This is how others will see you on the site.
unavailable: This settings area is not available in this workspace yet.
invalidTimezone: Select a valid IANA timezone identifier.
saveUncertain: The save outcome is uncertain. Refresh saved preferences before retrying.
timezoneDescription: Choose a preferred time zone or use your browser default. The server validates time zone identifiers.
regionalDescription: Choose date, time and number formats, not the interface language.
regionalFallback: Your browser cannot use one of the selected values. The preview uses {{timezone}} and {{locale}} without changing saved preferences.
savedRegional: Saved time zone: {{timezone}}. Saved regional format: {{locale}}. These settings control how dates, numbers and schedules are displayed. New scheduling editors use the saved effective timezone; existing meeting instants are never changed.
fontDescription: Set the font used throughout the application.
appearanceThemeDescription: Select the application theme. System follows your device.
appearanceStorage: Appearance preferences are stored in this browser.
appliedAppearance: Applied appearance: {{theme}} theme, {{font}} font. Only your edited selections will be applied.
profileStale: The profile version needs to be reviewed before saving.
profileSaveUncertain: The save outcome could not be confirmed. Review the server value before retrying.
displayNameDescription: Your name as shown in meetings and the member directory.
organizationInformationDescription: These values are managed by your organization and cannot be edited here.
reviewLatestDescription: Refresh and review the saved value before another update.
keepProfileDraft: Keep my draft against this version
meetingEmailsDescription: Invitations, participant changes, rescheduling and cancellations.
actionEmailsDescription: Notifications when work is assigned or reassigned to you.
optionalEmailsDescription: Turning off optional emails does not affect your meeting participation or assigned work. Preferences control email eligibility and do not guarantee delivery.
securityEmailsDescription: Essential account and security communications cannot be disabled.
